description: Find reader offers and vendor offers on our deal pages (discounts, extra credits, longer trials, conditional pilots). Each row has the evidence and its date, the verification status and the deadline in UTC. Expired offers are left out unless include_expired. Ranking is alphabetical, never by discount size or commission.

confirmed_only.description: true to return only offers the vendor confirmed in writing.
confirmed_only.title: Confirmed Only

include_expired.description: true to also return offers whose deadline has passed.
include_expired.title: Include Expired

offer_type.description: Only return offers of this type.
offer_type.title: Offer Type

product_id.description: The product's id, from the id field of a search_products result (e.g. 'toggl'). Leave empty for all products.
product_id.title: Product Id

query.description: Product name or words from the offer, e.g. 'annual discount'. Leave empty to list all.
query.title: Query

name: search_offers
